profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at St. Jude Children's Research Hospital
profile.summary:
CORE EXPERTISE
• Significant experience with rapid web designing using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python web framework - Django.
• Considerable experience working under clinical software development environment to design clinical LIMS, following 21crf part 11 regulations.
• Strong background in gene network analysis and downstream processing of NGS and microarray data.
• Experience with bioinformatics algorithm development and NGS programming in Perl, Python, C, C++, Shell Scripting, Command Line Interface (CLI) and Java on Windows, Mac and Linux platform.
• Experience with software development for gene network visualization using Cytoscape/ Java.
• Exceptional visualization skill using D3.js, Shiny, and Spotfire.
• Familiarity with current Bioinformatics web tools, databases and software packages.

SUMMARY OF ACCOMPLISHMENTS
• Developed BBI Toolkit with 3 major and 4 small web tools for Boston Biomedical within a year following rapid web development process.
• Developed NIBR Genome - a collective of genomes, annotations, aligner indexes, probe alignments, GTFJID-YEP files, research applications, and bioinformatics services.
• Developed web tool for SNP annotation using Python web framework - Django and HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
• Pathway visualization plugin development for JMP genomics using Java - Cytoscape, JMP Scripting language(JSL), MySQL and R.
• Designed bioinformatics web-tool for miRNA-mRNA interactions analysis.
• Designed Bioinformatics department website, GMU.
• Microarray Analysis of Interferon treated Daudi cell using MAdB, JMP genomics, Partek and R.
• NGS analysis pipeline for data from NGS platforms using various tools available on HPC web, Galaxy, Partek and CLC Genomics Workbench.
• Pathway analysis, Network visualization analysis and functional classification of genes related to Interferon treatment.

positions.title: Bioinformatics Engineer
positions.description:
Design and develop bioinformatics visualization tools for cancer and genomic research using Agile web development process.
• Active feature development of GenomePaint (https://genomepaint.stjude.cloud/) and ProteinPaint
(https://proteinpaint.stjude.org/) to visualizes somatic coding and noncoding alterations from ~3,800 pediatric tumors, along with multi-omics information using D3.js and javascript for
frontend and Node.js for backend with SQLite and genomics data as database.
•  Development of Survivorship Portal (https://proteinpaint.stjude.org/survivorship/) to share high quality genomic, clinical, and patient-reported data from pediatric cancer survivors and perform on the fly analysis of risk factor and cumulative burden.
•  Collaboration work with NCI to optimize and integrate ProteinPaint into the GDC portal as a major visualization tool for adult cancer variants.
•  Developed single cell viewer to visualize ~1 million single cells with expression and metadata using Three.js. The tool is heavily used by several portals such as Rhabdomyosarcoma Visualizations
(https://pecan.stjude.cloud/static/RMS-scrna-atlas-2020/) and Retina Nucleome paper
(https://pecan.stjude.cloud/retinalnucleome)

positions.title: Bioinformatics Scientist
positions.description:
Design and develop bioinformatics tools for cancer research pre-clinical research following Scrum project management and rapid web development process.

•	Develop a Pre-clinical tool for in-house mouse clinical trials to include mice randomization, colony management, drug dosage, sample collection, and data visualization.
•	Developed pipeline for analysis and quantification of Fluorescent microscopic images of various cell lines, identify and classify various cell types using classification algorithm and generate publication level graphs. Pipeline developed using CellProfiler tool and python.

positions.title: Bioinformatics Research Associate
positions.description:
Developed BBI Toolkit with three major and four small web tools for Discovery Research Dept. within 12 months following rapid web development process.

•  Developed first aiRNA prediction algorithm and web-tool using Django web-framework and various machine learning approach; significantly faster and more intuitive than existing siRNA tools
• Designed web tool for multiple sequence alignment using Bowtie; 2X faster and accurate than Blast
• Developed Biomarker lookup tool using existing public database for gene expression and cell lines and applied machine learning and statistical analysis to find novel biomarkers based on IC50 data for in-house drugs in development. Data visualization and plots using D3.js and Shiny with features like sort, filter, zoom, download.
• Designed and implemented LIMS system fulfilling 21crf part 11 guideline for Clinical sample management, varying from slides, blocks, tissue and blood samples using web framework and database. Specified and managed different access level for various user groups because of high sensitivity of information stored in database

positions.title: Bioinformatics Specialist
positions.description:
Enhanced software / web-tools by adding new features, bug-fixing and deploying new versions using web development technologies such as JAVA, JAVASCRIPT, CSS, XML, JSP and tools such as ECLIPSE, SVN, oracle server and WebLogic server.

•	Developed and maintained NIBR Genome, a collective of genomes, annotations, aligner indexes (BLAST, bowtie, bwa, STAR, Tophat, cufflink etc.), probe alignments, GTF-JID-YEP files, research applications, and bioinformatics services using Shell Scripting, YAML, PYTHON, JAVA, Command Line Interface (CLI) and various bioinformatics tools for indexing and NGS file creation.
•	Ran pipelines for NGS analysis for SNP calling, RNASeq using tools such as GATK, Tuxedo, STAR, BAW and R- Bioconductor.
•	Designed and monitored Bioinformatics and Life Science software / web tools using JAVA, JAVASCRIPT, CSS, XML, JSP, LINUX, Shell Scripting, VISUAL BASIC for Cardiovascular and Metabolic Diseases (CVM) and Oncology (ONC) department. 
•	Provided database management and maintenance using MYSQL, ORACLE, SQL DEVELOPER, .NET and CHADO for local copy of bioinformatics databases.

positions.title: Bioinformatician
positions.description:
Performed microarray analysis of Interferon treated Daudi cell using various bioinformatics tools based on Perl, Python, Java, R. Provided pathway analysis, Network visualization analysis and functional classification using tools such as Cytoscape, IPA, MIMI, Pathway Commons, Agilent literature and Genemania. 

•	Developed pathway visualization plugin for JMP genomics.
•	Conducted NGS analysis pipeline for data from NGS platforms, primarily Illumina Hiseq 2000 using HPC web using high-performance computing, perl, python, R, shell scripting.
•	Delivered pathway visualization plugin development for JMP genomics using Java - Cytoscape, JMP Scripting language (JSL), MySQL and R.

projects.title: Snippy - SNP annotation web tool using Django
projects.description:
• Single destination tool for SNP Annotation – simple point and click tool – easy to use design
• Designed using Python web framework – Django, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Jquery.
• Database – SQLite. Using RESTful Webservices to talk with third party databases. 
• Hosted on Amazon web server.
• Using SNP annotation tools such as OncoTator from Broad Institute and visualization tool as Cytoscape.

projects.title: MIAMI: A graphical interface web-tool for integrated miRNA-mRNA interaction analyses in Drosophila melanogaster
projects.description: This thesis describes the design and implementation of a web-based tool – MIAMI (miRNA and mRNA integrated analysis) – that enables integrative analysis of target predictions, miRNA and gene expression data. MIAMI is divided into two parts: the query section and the analysis section. The query section allows the user to retrieve and browse updated miRNA-mRNA pairs predicted using a number of different computational algorithms such as PITA, miRanda and Target Scan as well as Boolean combinations of these algorithms. The analysis section comprises a multi-step procedure for (i) performing various statistical analyses of mRNA and miRNA expression data; (ii) visualization of networks of the highest confidence miRNA and mRNA interactions and; (iii) retrieval of gene, miRNA and disease-specific information available in several public databases via scientific literature text-mining.
